User Profile

Welcome, {{ username }}!

Your comment: {{ comment }}

{% if username == 'admin' %}

Password Hint: {{ admin_pw }}

{% endif %} ''' # -------------------------------------------- comment = request.args.get('comment', 'No comment') admin_pw = ADMIN_PASSWORD if username == 'admin' else None return render_template_string(html_content, username=username, comment=comment, admin_pw=admin_pw) ```
